name: CTIB SwarmOrchestrator
description: Clinical Transition Intelligence Bus — Epistemic Handoff Agent. Orchestrates a swarm of 5 MCP constraint servers and 3 A2A agents to synthesize FHIR data + clinical notes into an EpistemicHandoffBundle for care transitions.

skills.name: Orchestrate Transition Analysis
skills.description: Runs the full CTIB Golden Path pipeline: SHARP context → FHIR fetch → 5-server MCP swarm → LLM synthesis → EpistemicHandoffBundle assembly → A2A delivery to receiving agent.
examples: Run a care transition analysis for patient pt-maria-chen-001
Generate an epistemic handoff bundle for ICU to step-down transfer

skills.name: Epistemic Handoff Bundle Generation
skills.description: Assembles a FHIR-native EpistemicHandoffBundle containing trajectory signals, orphaned intentions, temporal dissonance conflicts, and watch subscriptions.
examples: Assemble an epistemic handoff bundle from clinical signals

skills.name: Clinical Signal Synthesis
skills.description: Synthesizes unstructured clinical narratives and structured FHIR data into actionable clinical signals using LLM trajectory analysis.
examples: Synthesize clinical signals from progress notes and lab results
